opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode entertaining and enjoyed its humor.
Snow White’s changed demeanor was seen as compelling character development.
Commenters continued to show strong affection for Shadow Gale and Pfle.
The game-master’s role drew criticism, with commenters viewing the setup as unfair, while still finding the situation engaging.
The mind-control-related characterization was repeatedly described as unsettling.
